checks.name: whole duration syntax and inclusive1..180 bounds
strict six-key schema and safe finite values
ready/paused snapshot preserves exact remaining and ceiling seconds
running deadline,completion and rollback clamp derive without mutation
START and restart use configured duration with new independent records
PAUSE preserves millisecond remainder and disallows completed pause
RESUME uses saved remainder rather than full duration
RESET returns known configured ready state from all valid phases
CONFIGURE requires ready/completed and preserves active/paused record
invalid events,record,clock and deadline overflow cannot mutate valid data
persisted segment cannot exceed configured duration in paused or running
event prototype must be a plain own-field record
successful transitions do not mutate unfrozen input records or events
PAUSE under backward clock clamps to saved segment

limits: Pure timing/schema/transition checks only;not storage,browser,reference or commercial approval.
